Date : 12/01/2023  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE N.V.ANJARIA) Heard learned advocate Mr.C.P.Chaniyara for the applicant.
2. The jurisdiction of this court under the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 is invoked for the purpose of seeking compliance of the following directions which related to fixation and payment of compensation towards land acquisition.
The relevant directions in order and judgment dated 13.1.2022 in First Appeal concerned reads as under.

"In the result, the Appeals are partly allowed to the aforesaid extent and the amount is fixed at Rs.230/- per sq. mtrs. towards compensation to the respondents in the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be no order as to costs."

sentences.text: On plain reading of the directions, it could be seen that the court has not fixed any stipulated time for the purpose of compliance of the aforesaid directions regarding the payment of compensation.
At this stage, therefore, it cannot be said that the respondents have committed any willful disregard of the directions.
4. At the same time, the directions of the court cannot be permitted to remain uncomplied with.
The respondents are under obligation to comply with the directions, at the earliest, particularly when they relate to payment of compensation.

5. Therefore, the respondents are directed to act through their competent authority and carry out the directions above with regard to the fixation and payment of compensation within a period of six weeks from today.
Failing which they would be expose to the contempt of court.
The present application is accordingly disposed of.

(N.V.ANJARIA, J) (NIRAL R. MEHTA,J) Manshi Bhailalbhai Bapubhai Adatiya Decd. ... vs Gaurang Makwana Ias State Of Gujarat on 12 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193229800/
